title: Operating payments and segregated dispute balances
topic: Operating payments and segregated dispute balances
applicability: Custody fees and ordinary invoices paid by the same operating account.
content: The disputed incoming principal remains in its separate quarantine account. Only original-route return, the signed trustee deposit and a separately authorized owner claim may dispose that principal. Review and activation fees compete with ordinary supplier invoices for existing operating cash. A fee quote or bank acceptance says nothing about the ability to fund the other payment or its customer deadline. The trustee activation event does not itself pay a supplier. A slow review can require faster activation; buying both fastest services can cost more than the remaining operating balance permits. Customer deadlines are recorded in the custody contract.

provenance.boundary: Synthetic trustee onboarding and supplier credit terms added to the original bank products.
